segments.title: 第71章 群星環繞
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Era Chapter 71: Surrounded by Stars

In the afternoon, Class 7 and Class 8 had gym class together.

After talking with Ying Chanxi, Li Luo hurried to the sports field.

A male and a female teacher were in charge of their gym class. At the beginning, they led the warm-up exercises together.

But when it came time for specific activities, the boys and girls would separate, each led by one of the gym teachers.

This was also the reason why the class had to elect two PE representatives.

However, after about twenty minutes of exercise, the gym teacher announced free activity time.

The boys immediately swarmed toward the equipment room. Those who wanted basketballs grabbed basketballs, and those who wanted table tennis paddles grabbed those.

As for the girls, most of them either grabbed badminton rackets or just started to walk and stroll around.

Gao Yuqin, Class 7's monitor, didn't go to play badminton. Instead, she pulled her deskmate Zhang Yuanying toward the basketball courts.

"Which side are we going to watch?" Zhang Yuanying looked at the basketball courts, where boys from Class 7 and 8 were playing under three or four different hoops, feeling a bit overwhelmed by the choices.

Gao Yuqin herself was very sweet-looking. Although not as pretty as Ying Chanxi, she was still considered one of the little belles of Class 7.

Standing at the entrance to the basketball courts, she glanced inside a few times, then said, "Let's check them all out."

"Didn't you give a drink to that Li Luo from Class 8 before?" Zhang Yuanying pointed to a hoop in the corner. "What happened after that? Did he ever get you a gift in return or something?"

"No." Gao Yuqin wrinkled her nose. "I feel like he's a bit slow."

"What about the others?" Zhang Yuanying asked curiously. "Lu Wei from our class, or that Xu Tingwen from Class 3, didn't they both seem to have a good impression of you during military training?"

"They're both nice, too, but I prefer guys who can play the guitar and sing. Don't you think that's cool?" Gao Yuqin said. "And Li Luo even buys drinks and ice cream for his classmates. I think he's probably a very caring person."

"So what's your plan?"

"Let me think." Gao Yuqin pulled her deskmate along, walking toward the court where Li Luo was.

Because Li Luo had chosen a spot in the corner, Gao Yuqin naturally passed by the hoop where Lu Wei and the other boys from her class were playing.

The boys from Class 7 had originally thought their class monitor was coming to watch them play, and one by one, they suddenly started to play with ferocious intensity.

But when Gao Yuqin passed their hoop and headed toward Class 8's side, the group of boys was dumbfounded.

They thought to themselves, are you our class monitor or Class 8's?

Among the boys from Class 7, the tallest one, Lu Wei, watched Gao Yuqin's departing figure, unable to stop himself from pursing his lips. He glanced at the group of boys from Class 8, his gaze instantly locking onto Li Luo as he let out a scoff.

After all, many people had seen Gao Yuqin give a drink to Li Luo from Class 8.

But afterward, Gao Yuqin had also given drinks to Lu Wei and several other boys, so Lu Wei didn't think he was any worse off than Li Luo.

At this thought, Lu Wei couldn't help but say a few words to a classmate next to him. Then, he strode toward Class 8's side.

Before Gao Yuqin could get there, Lu Wei beat her to it and said to the Class 8 students, "It's no fun playing separately. Want to play a full-court 5v5? We can get a teacher to be the referee."

Zhu Yufei, as the PE representative, raised an eyebrow and looked at his classmates. Seeing that everyone was eager to try, he nodded and said, "Sure."

"I'll go get the teacher then, you guys wait a moment." Having received a reply, Lu Wei nodded with satisfaction. As he turned, he glanced at Gao Yuqin out of the corner of his eye before walking toward the gym teacher with a dashing posture.

Over on Class 8's side, Zhu Yufei began to pick his team. "Zhang Guohuang, Lin Yuan, Li Luo, Fang Chen, the five of us?"

"You guys play." Li Luo waved his hand, uninterested in running a full court. He patted the shoulder of the person next to him. "Lu Jiahao, you go. I'm going to rest."

It wasn't that he minded competing against the boys from Class 7. It was just that upon seeing the way that Lu Wei fellow was staring at him, and noticing the movements of that Gao Yuqin from Class 7, Li Luo felt a bit exasperated by this kind of thing.

So, Li Luo ambled over to the area under the hoop, rolling his neck as he prepared to leave.

But Gao Yuqin had already found him. She walked up to Li Luo and asked curiously, "You're not playing anymore?"

"Tired. Let them play."

"Eh?" Zhang Yuanying chimed in with a laugh from the side. "You're not scared, are you? Our Yuqin came here specifically to watch you play."

"Yingzi, what are you talking about," Gao Yuqin said with a coquettish pout, playfully hitting her. She then said to Li Luo, "Don't listen to her nonsense. I actually prefer watching you sing."

"Oh, thanks." Watching the two girls' routine, Li Luo felt goosebumps rise on his arms. It was a bit awkward for him to watch.

But Gao Yuqin wouldn't let him leave. She blocked his path and asked, "Are you free later? There's a club recruitment event this evening. Want to go check it out together?"

"No need. I feel like our interests are probably not the same."

"I want to check out the Dance Club and the Anime Club," Gao Yuqin said. "What about you?"

"Me?" Li Luo thought for a moment, then gave a perfunctory answer, "I got a perfect score on my high school entrance exam's Chinese essay, so of course I'm going to the Literature Club."

"The Literature Club?" Hearing him say that, Gao Yuqin changed her tune and said, "I was actually planning to check out the Literature Club too. We can go together later."

Li Luo: "...I already have plans with someone else, so I won't trouble you."

"It's fine, the more the merrier."

"Whatever." Seeing that she was going to keep pestering him, Li Luo suddenly understood the troubles of being popular. He decided to use the bathroom excuse to escape. "I'm going to the restroom."

Honestly, if a girl like Gao Yuqin had clung to him like this back in his high school days, Li Luo probably would have been utterly smitten.

But from an adult's perspective, Gao Yuqin's act only made him feel it was childish and awkward.

Thinking about it this way, Yan Zhusheng was much more normal.

Li Luo wandered over to a part of the sports field and saw Yan Zhusheng sitting alone under the shade of a tree. He couldn't help but walk over and ask, "Not playing badminton?"

"I was left out, no one to play with." Yan Zhusheng shook her head, pointing to the girls playing badminton over there.

"What about your roommate?" Li Luo asked with puzzlement. "Don't you usually hang out together?"

Yan Zhusheng blinked, asking back with some confusion, "Do roommates have to hang out together?"

"Well, not necessarily..." Li Luo clicked his tongue. He suddenly realized that Yan Zhusheng didn't seem to have any friends in the class.

To the boys, Yan Zhusheng's looks were truly a bit too dazzling, and she didn't seem very approachable.

Besides Li Luo, only Zhu Yufei, the PE representative, could exchange a few words with Yan Zhusheng.

As for the other girls... it felt like none of them really talked to Yan Zhusheng, nor had he ever seen her eat meals or go to the restroom with any other girl.

A bona fide lone wolf.

"I have nothing to do anyway. Come play badminton with me for a bit."

"Oh."

One minute later, Li Luo swung his arm with ease.

Three minutes later, Li Luo's expression was grave.

Five minutes later, Li Luo was running back and forth.

Ten minutes later, Li Luo was panting heavily, his hands on his knees. He looked at Yan Zhusheng on the opposite side, racket in hand, looking valiant and heroic, and couldn't help but ask, "Have you trained before?"

"My mom likes playing badminton, so I often play with her," Yan Zhusheng replied, then asked with concern, "Are you already spent?"

"?" Hearing this, Li Luo immediately puffed out his chest and pointed his racket straight at Yan Zhusheng. "Again!"

A few minutes later, the gym teacher's whistle blew, and the bell signaling the end of class rang along with it.

Li Luo let out a sigh of relief, thinking to himself that he could never play badminton with Yan Zhusheng again. It was so damn tiring.

He might as well have played basketball.

He clearly had the healthy body of a high school student, so why did it feel like Yan Zhusheng's physical fitness was better than his?

Thinking of this, on the way to return the rackets, Li Luo asked, "Do you exercise often?"

"I have a habit of morning and evening jogs," Yan Zhusheng said, tilting her head. "I mentioned it at the start of the school year, didn't I? I like music and running."

"I see..." Li Luo nodded in realization, but he shook his head inwardly. He thought, God must be blind. How could He bear to let a girl like this get a heart condition?

With these thoughts, after the students of Class 7 and 8 gathered, the gym teacher dismissed the class. Li Luo headed toward the academic building, planning to wait for Ying Chanxi to come down.

"Want to eat together?" Yan Zhusheng asked.

"Sure," Li Luo nodded. "Ying Chanxi will join us in a bit."

"Oh."

The two of them walked to the entrance of the sports field. By now, members of various clubs had already started setting up stalls along Houde Road.

Xu Youyu, wearing the red armband of the Student Union on her uniform sleeve, happened to be on temporary duty here. When she saw Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng, she waved and called out, "Going to eat?"

Just then, Ying Chanxi also came down from upstairs and ran over to find Li Luo. "Senior Sister and Zhusheng are here too? Let's go eat together."

At this very moment.

Gao Yuqin, who had been thinking of approaching them to say hello, was already holding Zhang Yuanying's hand, silently following the crowd toward the cafeteria.

Her rivals were simply too formidable; it wasn't that she was retreating before the fight.

(End of this chapter)
